description: Land Acquisition - Pothana, Ganewaththa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette notice is specifically about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed information about a particular land parcel (location, lot numbers, boundaries, extent, and description) and provides procedures for claimants regarding ownership rights and compensation. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition, property ownership matters, and land registration procedures.
